analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($67.90) vs SMA5 ($69.78)/SMA20 ($70.86)/SMA50 ($70.80): below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($72.92)/SMA200 ($61.99): mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.4→42.5): entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.3272→-0.3272): weak momentum holding, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $68.01): approaching lower band, with band width narrowing to 8.06%.

· Swing Resistance ($74.18): potential to test resistance if price moves above 5-day high ($72.55).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): confirming lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.80x): subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current Range Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach due to lack of buy/sell direction.
